steps.content: It seems logical to hide among spies by claiming to be one of them.

steps.speaker: Johnson
steps.content: I have the roster of every deep-cover asset within DisCity. I can say with absolute certainty your name is not on it.

steps.speaker: Johnson
steps.content: I'm afraid you have it backwards. You aren't infiltrating them. You are one of them.
Under the collective, hardening gazes of the room, you realize your critical error.
Hilda lets out a soft, almost disappointed sigh.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: I don't know how you found this place, but you've walked into a brutal slaughterhouse. This is no place for an unaffiliated journalist or a lost soul to go snooping.
Before you can speak, two guards seize you by the arms, hauling you roughly from the hall.
The massive doors boom shut, and in that same instant, pitch-black rain comes pouring down.
You reach out, only to find it is no rain but a torrent of pitch-black sludge, reeking of potent Mania.

It twists in your palm. It is alive. It swells and squirms against your skin, while what has already fallen slithers and pools at your feet. It climbs, coiling up your legs like insidious vines, exactly as it did within Hilda's consciousness.

The realization strikes you, and the world dissolves in its wake. Everything blurs, turning void and distant. You are back. Back in that vast, lightless expanse of consciousness, where all sense of direction is swallowed by an endless, suffocating dark.
